title: In reply to the comment on “Mixed reality-assisted orthognathic surgery with pre-bent titanium plates”
html: The thoughtful and constructive comments regarding our recent Technical Note, “Mixed reality-assisted orthognathic surgery with pre-bent titanium plates”, are sincerely appreciated1. It is encouraging to see that this work has generated academic interest and stimulated meaningful discussion. Mixed-reality (MR) technology has become a major topic in maxillofacial surgery over the past five years2,3. Our team has been actively exploring its application, particularly in titanium plate and screw positioning as well as bone segment positioning1,4,5.
